name: live-output-artifacts
description: Bundles your IR MCP server with live-artifact skills: auto-render any agent output as a live Cowork artifact, a Rockstar Agents command center (agents, skills, tools, plus an Outputs tab listing every deliverable your agents produced — filterable by client, agent, and skill), a Rockstar chat panel, and a Digital DNA workflow that scans your AI history into a MyGentic brain (persona / knowledge / skills), connects it over MCP, and proves the lift with a live before-vs-after scorecard.
